origin: docs/CWE-94/python Common Vulnerable Patterns: Template Injection (Jinja2 Unsafe)

finding.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
finding.summary: A request-supplied template string is stored as a draft and compiled with Jinja2 Environment.from_string(), giving the requester control over executable template source.

trap: Enabling autoescape is already present and does not constrain template source execution. Escaping only protects values inserted into HTML; it does not stop a user-authored Jinja template from accessing objects exposed in the render context.
must_preserve: A valid preview request still returns ({"preview": rendered_html}, 200), and a missing template still returns ({"error": "template is required"}, 400). The rendered preview still has access only to the intended user and campaign data.
